Project name: Clear Decisions Unified AI System for Structured and Unstructured Data
Industry: Services - Custom Software Development AI/ML Engineering Data Engineering System Architecture
Challenges: Integrating unstructured document retrieval with structured database querying in
a single system.​
Implementing semantic search over PDF documents using vector embeddings.​
Translating natural language queries into executable SQL statements.​
Designing dynamic query classification without stateful agent memory.​
Reducing latency and compute overhead while maintaining response accuracy.​
Delivering a production-ready MVP within strict time constraints.​
The Solution: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using Vertex AI
text-embedding-004 for embedding generation.​
Implemented Milvus as the vector database for semantic chunk storage and
retrieval.​
Integrated Gemini Pro for document re-ranking and response generation.​
Developed an NL2SQL module using Gemini Pro to convert natural language into
PostgreSQL queries.​
Executed SQL queries directly on PostgreSQL and returned structured tabular
outputs with explanations.​
Designed a lightweight function-based orchestration layer using
prompt-engineered classification logic to route queries between RAG and SQL
pipelines.​
Replaced planned agentic architecture with modular function orchestration to
reduce system complexity and improve deployment speed.​
